content.title: Charlie May - 2023-24 Men's Basketball
content.text: Open Roster Player DropdownName PronunciationREDSHIRT FRESHMAN (2023-24) Played in six games, coming off the bench in all, and seeing 10:02 of game action Made his collegiate debut against FIU in UCF's season-opener on Nov. 6 Earned his first collegiate steal on Dec. 29 against Bethune-Cookman Pulled in a rebound in three consecutive appearances against Lipscomb (Dec. 2), Jacksonville (Dec. 6) and Maine (Dec. 18) FRESHMAN (2022-23) Did not see game action during the 2022-23 season, earning a redshirt PRIOR TO UCF Helped St. Andrews to a state championship in his sophomore season Earned three district titles from his freshman to junior years Was the team captain of his St. Andrews squad in his senior season PERSONAL His father, Dusty May, was announced as the 18th head coach of Michigan's men's basketball team on Sunday, March 24, 2024. Prior to committing to lead the Wolverines, Coach May was at the helm of Florida Atlantic's program for six seasons, leading the Owls to their first NCAA Final Four during the 2022-23 season and leading them back to the NCAA Tournament the following season. His brother, Jack May, is a guard on Florida’s men’s basketball roster and completed his redshirt junior campaign during the 2023-24 season. Freshman2022-23
